name: Reconator
description: Result-driven reconnaissance knowledge framework — FastAPI, PostgreSQL, workers, and React

ADMIN_API_KEY.description: Required API key protecting mutations and reconnaissance intelligence. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

TELEGRAM_API_KEY.description: Telegram bot API key from @BotFather. Leave blank to disable notifications.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Telegram chat id (use @chat_id_echo_bot). Leave blank to disable notifications.

WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional Slack/Discord/generic webhook for scan notifications.

SENTRY_DSN.description: Optional Sentry DSN for error tracking.

PROTECT_READ_ENDPOINTS.description: Require the API key for asset, evidence, task, and scan reads.

WORKER_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: How often the worker polls for queued targets.
